_comment: PUBLIC channel facts only. The stream KEY is never stored here or anywhere in this repo — Oluwatoba enters it directly in OBS on his own machine at go-live, and nowhere else.

kickChat._comment: Read-only in v1. Adapter contract is in js/chat.js. Channel slug is public; no token is needed to read public chat, and no credentials may be committed. bridgeUrl (set in stream.local.json) points the scene at the local chat bridge, scripts/chat-service.js — the route that works in the streaming browser; empty = in-browser adapter.

rtmp._comment: Fill in LOCALLY in OBS only, at go-live. Leave blank in the repo.

voice._comment: Local TTS voice bridge (scripts/voice-service.js). Empty = off. Set in stream.local.json to http://127.0.0.1:8379/say when the voice service runs.
